what: Twenty entries in the BT series concern pseudo-resolvents, Fourier coefficients and perturbation estimates (typed analysis exercises), not Barsotti-Tate groups. Their "BT" label places them in the wrong cluster; their source is not identified (compare SA03-19, the operator-semigroup typescript of the same cote).
The package includes cote 161 (offprints on p-adic representations, Sen's theorem, the algebraic envelope). It belongs with the p-adic material, which the topic list does not name.
Good reduction of abelian varieties via Barsotti-Tate groups (cote 100) is the same programme as the BT crystals of cote 93.
The recollement notes of cote 102 are headed "Pour EGA VI": a draft for the unpublished EGA VI (descent), with "Recollements d'objets d'un site".
The local-cohomology notes of cote 101 carry "Notes antiques" and 1958, with "Caractérisation des Coh. M., des Gorensteins etc": an early date for SA04-39 (= H038).

Reused and dated sheets bound the combinatorial-geometry notes of cotes 69-80 to about 1975-1981: 16 Nov 1975 (K78-08), the Bourbaki seminar of 19-21 June 1976 (K74-03), 17 June 1976 (K70-08), thesis notices and letters of 1977 (K74-01, K77-06, K78-07), December 1977 (K70-02, K77-05), 1980 (K79-19), 1981 (K79-03, K80-02). Dates of reused sheets give a terminus post quem only.
His own "faux" and "C'est faux" marks beside statements on these leaves: self-corrections recorded by the Codex notes; the items' status on the pages includes these corrections.
